name: titleshield
description: TitleShield (BhoomiTrust) — autonomous 30-year property title search, encumbrance scoring, signed Title Clearance Certificates and programmable escrow.

scripts.dev: npm run db:migrate && concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/core && npm run test -w apps/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web
